## Notes

Paradox Development Studio, Paradox Interactive, August 2013 (infobox 13, body 25); Windows, OS X, Linux. Over 500 playable nations, 1444 to 1821, no strict win condition. Administrative, diplomatic, and military monarch power buys technology; institutions spread by province; trade nodes and merchants; alliances, vassals, coalitions; estates; random and historical events; Ironman mode.
